# NVO987 Bookstore

> NVO987 is the independent publishing imprint of Nicholas Van-Orton.
> It publishes research-based books and publications focused on art,
> visual culture, art history, history, documentation, and cultural memory.

Canonical URL:
https://books.nvo987.us/

## Publisher

Nicholas Van-Orton is an independent researcher and the founder
of NVO987.

NVO987 is a multidisciplinary artistic and cultural initiative
exploring the intersections of visual culture and art history.

Main website:
https://nvo987.us/

Organization:
https://nvo987.fr/

## Bookstore

The NVO987 Bookstore presents books, research publications,
and independent editorial works.
